figures.name: overview
figures.title: Overview (`result.plot()`)
figures.shows: The figure that `result.plot()` saves: (a) clonal programmes on the clone map, (b) clonal coherence, (c) programme stability, (d) programme sizes.

figures.name: coherence
figures.title: Clonal coherence
figures.shows: Share of transcriptional variance explained by clone identity (clonal ICC), observed and with clone labels shuffled within each `sample` (bar: mean of 200 permutations; whisker: their central 95 %).

figures.name: clone_map_programmes
figures.title: Clone map: programmes
figures.shows: The clone map (UMAP of clone profiles; one point per clone, area by its number of cells) coloured by clonal programme, one panel per programme, every other clone in grey.

figures.name: clone_map_clone_size
figures.title: Clone map: clone size
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the number of cells of each clone.

figures.name: clone_map_reliability
figures.title: Clone map: profile reliability
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the reliability of each clone's profile (0 to 1; it grows with the number of cells sampled from the clone).

figures.name: clone_map_donor
figures.title: Clone map: donor
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by donor, one panel per donor, every other clone in grey.

figures.name: clone_map_rbd_bait
figures.title: Clone map: rbd_bait
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `rbd_bait`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: clone_map_division_gate
figures.title: Clone map: division_gate
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `division_gate`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: clone_map_zone_gate
figures.title: Clone map: zone_gate
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `zone_gate`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: clone_map_isotype
figures.title: Clone map: isotype
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `isotype`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: stability
figures.title: Programme stability
figures.shows: Bootstrap stability of each programme (mean Jaccard overlap with the best-matching group over 30 bootstrap replicates), with the 0.75 (stable) and 0.6 guides.

figures.name: composition_rbd_bait_cells
figures.title: Programme composition: rbd_bait (cells)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the fraction of the programme's cells in each level of `rbd_bait` (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_rbd_bait_clones
figures.title: Programme composition: rbd_bait (clones)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the mean over the programme's clones of each clone's fraction of cells in each level of `rbd_bait`, so that every clone counts once (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_division_gate_cells
figures.title: Programme composition: division_gate (cells)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the fraction of the programme's cells in each level of `division_gate` (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_division_gate_clones
figures.title: Programme composition: division_gate (clones)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the mean over the programme's clones of each clone's fraction of cells in each level of `division_gate`, so that every clone counts once (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_zone_gate_cells
figures.title: Programme composition: zone_gate (cells)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the fraction of the programme's cells in each level of `zone_gate` (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_zone_gate_clones
figures.title: Programme composition: zone_gate (clones)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the mean over the programme's clones of each clone's fraction of cells in each level of `zone_gate`, so that every clone counts once (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_isotype_cells
figures.title: Programme composition: isotype (cells)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the fraction of the programme's cells in each level of `isotype` (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_isotype_clones
figures.title: Programme composition: isotype (clones)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the mean over the programme's clones of each clone's fraction of cells in each level of `isotype`, so that every clone counts once (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: label_effects
figures.title: Label effects
figures.shows: For each tested label, the share of the variance between clone profiles that it explains (blue) and the same with the label shuffled among clones of the same donor and of similar size (grey), with the permutation P value.

figures.name: association_rbd_bait
figures.title: Programme association: rbd_bait
figures.shows: Clone-level association of each programme with `rbd_bait`: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio within donor x clone-size bins with its 95 % CI, one panel per level. Filled markers: FDR < 0.05.

figures.name: association_division_gate
figures.title: Programme association: division_gate
figures.shows: Clone-level association of each programme with `division_gate`: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio within donor x clone-size bins with its 95 % CI, one panel per level. Filled markers: FDR < 0.05.

figures.name: association_zone_gate
figures.title: Programme association: zone_gate
figures.shows: Clone-level association of each programme with `zone_gate`: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio within donor x clone-size bins with its 95 % CI, one panel per level. Filled markers: FDR < 0.05.

figures.name: association_isotype
figures.title: Programme association: isotype
figures.shows: Clone-level association of each programme with `isotype`: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio within donor x clone-size bins with its 95 % CI, one panel per level; levels whose odds ratios are all 0 or infinite cannot be placed on a log axis and are left out (IGHD). Filled markers: FDR < 0.05.

figures.name: memory_division_gate
figures.title: Clonal memory over division_gate
figures.shows: How much a clone's profile changes between levels of `division_gate`, against other clones of the same donor seen at the same two levels; the title gives the memory index with its 95 % CI.

figures.name: heritability
figures.title: Gene heritability
figures.shows: Clonal ICC of every gene expressed in at least 5 % of the cells of clones with two or more cells (receptor genes excluded), by rank; the 12 highest are named (`tl.gene_heritability` with its defaults).

figures.name: cells_programmes
figures.title: Cells: programmes
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each programme's clones, one panel per programme, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_rbd_bait
figures.title: Cells: rbd_bait
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `rbd_bait`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_division_gate
figures.title: Cells: division_gate
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `division_gate`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_zone_gate
figures.title: Cells: zone_gate
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `zone_gate`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_isotype
figures.title: Cells: isotype
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `isotype`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: signatures
figures.title: Marker signatures by programme
figures.shows: Mean log-normalised expression of the case-study marker sets (plasma cell, germinal centre, dark zone / cycling, light zone, memory, naive, interferon) in the cells of each programme, z-scored across programmes.
